sections.content: position values: static (default), relative (offset from itself), absolute (relative to positioned ancestor), fixed (viewport), sticky (scrolls until threshold).
absolute removes from flow — siblings ignore it; fixed stays during scroll; sticky is the modern nav pattern.
Key points: absolute needs a positioned ancestor (else it uses viewport), z-index only works on positioned elements, and sticky needs a scroll threshold like top:0.
